title: A Little Off In Person
text: A Little Off In Person. I am using this as storage for my baby wraps. I like the look from far away. It does not look like the image photo. In real life, the gold is mounted to a white piece of wood. The wood has two D-rings on the back to hang it. The “shelves” are not quite all even. Some are a little further to the side than others. But they are too close to the same to be properly asymmetrical. I’m not completely hating it, but it doesn’t look as nice in person.

product_metadata.title: Amazon Brand – Rivet Mid Century Modern Wood Floating Wall Mounted Wine Rack - 27.8 Inch, Gold and White
features: White wood and gold-finished metal come together to form a handsome and convenient wine rack that doubles as wall art. With the capacity to hold six wine bottles horizontally, this functional piece is a perfect complement to a modern or industrial style room.
